description_blocks.text: Overview

The Crazy Factory is an engaging 3D-printed game where players guide a robot through a chaotic factory filled with gears and misaligned conveyor belts. Its key selling points include dual controller options (standard remote or custom joystick), A1-Mini compatibility, adjustable package release speed, and clever mechanical design that challenges players to deliver packages without dropping them. Built around CyberBrick, it offers hands-on, chaotic fun for 3D printing enthusiasts.
This model is offered as a crowdfunding project. Your purchase involves two steps:
1. Purchase the necessary parts kit on this page to assemble your model.
2. Get the 3D print files by backing the project on the crowdfunding page.

*The Crazy Factory is continuously improved based on feedback from our players and makers. The Creator is actively refining models, mechanics, and components based on community feedback. For the latest updates, upgrade files, and additional content, be sure to follow the project’s page on MakerWorld.
Package Dispatch Mechanism

Packages are dispatched automatically at two selectable speeds, letting you control the pace and difficulty of the game. Start with up to 6 cubes loaded at once, or continue refilling them while the factory is in motion.
Playful Factory Theme

Crazy conveyor belts, charming details, and a choice between visible or hidden mechanisms give the model its unique factory character. The playful design makes it entertaining to explore, enjoyable to watch, and full of surprises.
Fast and Precise Robot Movement
The robot’s quick movement puts your timing and skill to the test. Master fast and smooth control to catch every package before it drops.
Stop Time at the Push of a Button

CPause the conveyor action instantly with the push of a button and use the moment to catch two packages at once. But stay alert — new packages can still be released even while the conveyors are stopped.Pause the conveyor action instantly with the push of a button and use the moment to catch two packages at once. But stay alert — new packages can still be released even while the conveyors are stopped.
Detailed Assembly Instructions

Comes with detailed step-by-step assembly instructions designed to make the build as smooth and enjoyable as possible. Despite its many moving parts and mechanisms, every step is clearly explained, well illustrated, and easy to follow.
Remote Control Instruction
The Model is designed to work with the CyberBrick Official Remote. Pre-configured settings has been prepared for immediate play,
while the CyberBrick App allows full customization of controller functions to match your personal preferences.
* Please visit the CyberBrick Official Standard Remote on Makerworld for more details.

Core Safety Rules
This product is intended for users aged 14 and above. Users under the age of 14 must be under direct adult supervision throughout use.
DO NOT touch the moving parts while the device is operating to prevent pinching injuries.
Please use only official tools for any firmware operations. Flashing with third-party tools is not supported and may cause irreversible damage, which is not covered by warranty.
Before use, inspect all 3D-printed parts and sand down any sharp edges or burrs if present. Store the model and small parts in a location out of reach of children and pets to prevent choking hazards.
Warning of Lithium Battery
This product utilizes a replaceable rechargeable lithium battery.
Adult supervision is required when children are handling batteries or the charger. Do not operate the product while it is charging.
Ensure the battery is installed correctly. Improper installation may result in short circuits, overheating, or potential explosion.
Regularly inspect the charger’s cord, plug, housing, and other components for damage. If any damage is found, discontinue use immediately until the device is fully repaired.
Choking Hazard: Contains small parts; not suitable for children under 3 years of age.
Improper disposal of this product may harm the environment - please recycle responsibly.
Charging Precautions
Use only the officially supplied charger. The charger is not a toy.

The USB charger for this product only supports standard 5V 1-2A input. Please always use the original charger that meets the voltage/current requirements, or charge directly via a computer USB port. DO NOT use chargers with output higher than 5V or 2A (such as mobile fast chargers, 9V/12V adapters, etc.), as this may cause device damage, overheating, or even serious fire hazards.
DO NOT cover the device while charging, and keep it away from high temperature, humidity, or flammable environments. Never charge the device unattended.
DO NOT charge the battery pack if it is overheating. Allow it to cool down completely before recharging.
If the battery pack or charger becomes wet, ensure they are thoroughly dry before attempting to charge.
Lithium Battery Safety Precautions
DO NOT attempt to use or charge the battery pack if it shows any signs of leakage or corrosion.
DO NOT disassemble, crush, or mechanically abuse the battery pack.
DO NOT dispose of the battery pack in fire.
Exercise extreme caution when handling an overheated battery pack.

Important Notices

Core Safety Rules

  • This product is intended for users aged 14 and above. Users under the age of 14 must be under direct adult supervision throughout use.
  • DO NOT touch the moving parts while the device is operating to prevent pinching injuries.
  • Please use only official tools for any firmware operations. Flashing with third-party tools is not supported and may cause irreversible damage, which is not covered by warranty.
  • Before use, inspect all 3D-printed parts and sand down any sharp edges or burrs if present. Store the model and small parts in a location out of reach of children and pets to prevent choking hazards.

Warning of Lithium Battery

  • This product utilizes a replaceable rechargeable lithium battery.
  • Adult supervision is required when children are handling batteries or the charger. Do not operate the product while it is charging.
  • Ensure the battery is installed correctly. Improper installation may result in short circuits, overheating, or potential explosion.
  • Regularly inspect the charger’s cord, plug, housing, and other components for damage. If any damage is found, discontinue use immediately until the device is fully repaired.
  • Choking Hazard: Contains small parts; not suitable for children under 3 years of age.
  • Improper disposal of this product may harm the environment - please recycle responsibly.

Charging Precautions

  • Use only the officially supplied charger. The charger is not a toy.
  • The USB charger for this product only supports standard 5V 1-2A input. Please always use the original charger that meets the voltage/current requirements, or charge directly via a computer USB port. DO NOT use chargers with output higher than 5V or 2A (such as mobile fast chargers, 9V/12V adapters, etc.), as this may cause device damage, overheating, or even serious fire hazards.
  • DO NOT cover the device while charging, and keep it away from high temperature, humidity, or flammable environments. Never charge the device unattended.
  • DO NOT charge the battery pack if it is overheating. Allow it to cool down completely before recharging.
  • If the battery pack or charger becomes wet, ensure they are thoroughly dry before attempting to charge.

Lithium Battery Safety Precautions

  • DO NOT attempt to use or charge the battery pack if it shows any signs of leakage or corrosion.
  • DO NOT disassemble, crush, or mechanically abuse the battery pack.
  • DO NOT dispose of the battery pack in fire.
  • Exercise extreme caution when handling an overheated battery pack.
